subject.title: [Bug]: openai-responses sends role="system" instead of role="developer" for reasoning models

question: Should OpenClaw support this strict OpenAI-compatible Responses relay class in core, and if so should the fix be a focused `reasoning` propagation repair, an opt-in prompt-placement compatibility setting, or no core change?
rationale: Current main supports OpenAI-valid request shapes and already protects providers that reject `developer`, while the reported relay rejects `system` and the active PR adds new public config surface.

options.title: Require focused repro before choosing surface
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a current-main captured request or focused test proving whether `reasoning: true` is lost before deciding between a bug repair and a config surface.

options.title: Sponsor opt-in strict-relay compatibility
options.body: Accept the product direction behind the open PR or a rebased replacement that preserves defaults and documents a strict-relay `instructions` placement mode.

options.title: Decline proxy-specific core support
options.body: Close or mark not planned unless the failure reproduces against official OpenAI or a proxy that accepts the official Responses contract while OpenClaw still sends the wrong shape.

recommendation.title: Require focused repro before choosing surface
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a current-main captured request or focused test proving whether `reasoning: true` is lost before deciding between a bug repair and a config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the clearest related maintainer policy signal on strict Responses proxy compatibility in the linked tracker.
